definitions.explanation: The speed at which music is played.
The speed or pace of an activity or conversation.

examples.japanese: テンポ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
テンポ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧テンポ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦{弾|ひ}いてみてください→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Try playing it at a slightly slower tempo.
The conversation flows at a good pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧テンポ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がってきた→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The pace of work has picked up.

examples.english: This movie had great pacing and I was engaged until the end.

notes:
テンポ refers to the speed of music or the pace of activities and conversation.

ETYMOLOGY:
From Italian "tempo" (time).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- テンポ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: fast tempo/pace
- テンポ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: slow tempo/pace
- テンポ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to speed up
- テンポ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to slow down
- テンポ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: good rhythm/flow

USAGE:
Used for both musical tempo and general pace:
- ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧テンポ: tempo of a song
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧テンポ: pace of conversation
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧テンポ: work pace

RELATED WORDS:
